accelerator_bound.caps_note: The caps follow the PORT arm table (phase-native-module-v1-c17, 17 contacts per row: the historical 15 plus the replicate's Perception and Solver contact): generation = rows x (17 + 17 fallback), FIT = rows x 17 x 1 counting endpoint (the raw-audio arm; the historical packet arm made 4), audio = ceil(roster speech-seconds x the generation contacts per row).

formula.arm: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours = ceil_0.1(1.3 x 1,080 rows x 8.52 lock-row equivalents x T / r / 60), T = tensor-parallel size (cards per instance), r = the measured lock-only rows per minute of ONE instance at its chosen sequences per instance; the instance count cancels (wall-clock = card-hours / (instances x T)); T and r from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep)
formula.smoke: PROVISIONAL NPU card-hours = 0.5 h wall-clock allowance x instances x T (every held card), from PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep)

illustration_not_registered.note: at the historical llama.cpp lock rate the flight bound would read 90.3 x T card-hours; the port's r is measured, not assumed

context_fit.note: The Solver prompt mean is about 8,500 tokens against the 4,096 cap (prompt limit 17,406). Every arm renders the lock's template and the lock's evidence; a sampling parameter adds no prompt token, so the sealed Fold B Solver prompt maximum is the bound of every arm. The context-fit policy is compact-or-abstain, and the exact per-contact gate runs on every arm's REAL request. The port keeps the per-sequence window (--max-model-len 24576); the token counts are the historical llama.cpp tokenizer estimates and observations, re-checked on every REAL request by the exact per-contact gate.
context_fit.sequences_per_instance: PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE (pending; filled from the measured speed sweep)
context_fit.template_token_method: ceil(bytes / 3.5); no tokenizer contact (the NX R1 estimate method)

declared_differences: 8.1 BF16 weights instead of GGUF Q4_K_M; BF16 KV instead of q8_0
8.2 audio features computed by the server's audio tower from the raw audio instead of llama.cpp mmproj packets
8.3 vLLM sampling and kernels: temperature 0 with a fixed seed is deterministic per server build, not bit-identical to llama.cpp
8.4 causal retrieval encoder (forced and measured); every sealed retrieval vector regenerated
8.7 CPU float32 retrieval encoder instead of CUDA bfloat16
execution_route: The shared core.flight.cli FIT path under this cell's own native_contact_fit ids; request envelopes only, no generation.
one_factor: None within the cell beyond the historical sampling levers; against the historical twin the port changes the serving stack, the speech input path, the retrieval vectors and the authored knowledge together (the declared differences), so it is read beside the historical flight, never as a one-factor contrast with it.
